Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Yes, damaged items are handled differently from normal returns!
Damaged Items (Manufacturing Defects):
When an issue is caused by Avocado's manufacturing or logistics teams, you can qualify for a replacement instead of needing to go through the standard return process. This includes situations like:
Wrong size, model, or color arriving
Visible defects after opening and inspecting the packaging
Damage that occurred during shipping
For furniture that arrives damaged, you should contact us within 3 days of delivery to arrange a repair, replacement, or return. Returns due to verified manufacturing defects are eligible for a full refund or replacement, including shipping fees, under our warranty.
Normal Returns:
Standard returns (like comfort preference or change of mind) follow our regular return policy, which includes:
Sleep trial adjustment periods
Restocking fees for furniture (20%)
Non-refundable shipping fees
The key difference is that damaged or defective items don't have restocking fees and shipping costs are covered when the issue is verified as a manufacturing defect. All replacement requests need to be reviewed by our team, and additional documentation may be required before a replacement is approved.
